problem_description: A very small surface variation is visible on a few molded parts, but production remains stable.
comment: Less than 1% of parts are affected. No production loss, safety concern, or equipment risk observed.

problem_description: Injection pressure occasionally drops below the validated process window and causes incomplete filling.
comment: Production capacity is reduced by approximately 15%. Around 8% of parts show incomplete filling. No safety risk.

problem_description: Smoke and a burning smell were detected near the electrical control cabinet during production.
comment: The machine was immediately stopped due to potential fire and electrical equipment risk.

problem_description: Cycle time is slightly above the normal validated range but remains stable.
comment: Production output is reduced by less than 5%. No measurable quality issue or safety concern.

problem_description: Process temperature is above the validated window and product quality has deteriorated.
comment: Production capacity is reduced by around 20%. Approximately 18% of parts require rework or are rejected.

problem_description: A significant hydraulic oil leak was detected close to hot machine components.
comment: Production was stopped immediately because continued operation could cause fire, injury, or serious equipment damage.

problem_description: A small amount of flash appears on several parts while the process remains stable.
comment: Around 4% of parts have minor cosmetic flash. Production capacity is unaffected and no safety risk exists.

problem_description: The ejection mechanism intermittently requires an additional cycle before the part is released.
comment: Production capacity is reduced by approximately 20%. About 5% of parts have minor handling defects.

problem_description: The mold repeatedly fails to close correctly and production cannot continue.
comment: Production is fully stopped. Maintenance intervention is required and continued attempts may damage the clamping system.

problem_description: A process sensor shows a small stable offset compared with a reference measurement.
comment: Production and quality remain normal. No meaningful operational or safety impact has been observed.

problem_description: Process temperature is below the validated range and causes inconsistent material flow.
comment: Around 12% of parts are defective and production capacity is reduced by about 10%.

problem_description: Injection pressure fluctuates strongly and repeatedly reaches values far outside the validated range.
comment: More than 40% of parts are rejected and production capacity has fallen by approximately 40%. Equipment stress is clearly visible.

problem_description: Material feeding stopped briefly and automatically resumed.
comment: Approximately 2% of parts showed minor defects. Production returned immediately to normal.

problem_description: Cycle time has increased substantially compared with the validated production condition.
comment: Production capacity is reduced by around 18%. Product quality remains acceptable and no safety concern exists.

problem_description: The machine safety guard does not reliably trigger the expected stop function.
comment: Operation was stopped immediately because personnel could be exposed to moving machine components.

problem_description: Small cosmetic marks are visible on a limited number of parts.
comment: Around 5% of parts show minor cosmetic defects but remain usable. Production is unaffected.

problem_description: Injection pressure remains below the validated range and produces incomplete filling.
comment: Approximately 15% of parts require rework or scrap. Production capacity is reduced by around 12%.

problem_description: The cooling system is not functioning correctly and mold temperature continues to rise.
comment: Production capacity has fallen by more than 35% and around 35% of parts are rejected. Continued production could damage tooling.

problem_description: Pressure and cycle time remain near the limits of the validated process window.
comment: About 2.5% of parts show minor cosmetic variation. No measurable production loss or safety issue exists.

problem_description: Material supply is irregular and occasionally interrupts the injection cycle.
comment: Production capacity is reduced by approximately 25%. Around 8% of parts show minor filling defects.

problem_description: The mold is mechanically blocked and cannot complete the opening sequence.
comment: Production is completely stopped for a prolonged period and maintenance intervention is required before operation can resume.

problem_description: A single machine alarm occurred but cleared automatically and has not repeated.
comment: No defective parts, production loss, equipment risk, or safety concern were observed.

problem_description: Process temperature is above the validated window and causes visible quality variation.
comment: Approximately 9% of parts are affected and production capacity is reduced by around 12%.

problem_description: A major dimensional deviation causes the molded component to fail its required safety-related function.
comment: Approximately 45% of produced parts are unusable and the defect is considered critical for product function.

problem_description: Cycle time fluctuates slightly around the normal validated range.
comment: Less than 1% of parts show any variation. Production capacity and equipment condition remain normal.

problem_description: Injection pressure repeatedly falls significantly below the validated process range.
comment: Production capacity is reduced by about 20%. Approximately 6% of parts show incomplete filling.

problem_description: The drive motor temperature increased rapidly and abnormal noise was detected.
comment: The machine was shut down immediately because continued operation could cause serious motor or machine damage.

problem_description: Production paused briefly due to a temporary material handling issue.
comment: Production resumed normally. No defective parts or equipment problems were detected.

problem_description: Temperature is below the validated range and cycle time has increased above the normal limit.
comment: Approximately 14% of parts require rework and production capacity is reduced by around 10%.

problem_description: Injection pressure is highly unstable and frequently collapses during the filling phase.
comment: Production capacity is reduced by more than 60%. Around 40% of parts are rejected and the process is no longer stable.
